page_title: BOU 0-1 WOL | Bournemouth v Wolves 22/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Kepa Arrizabalaga (Bournemouth) is booked.
90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Wolves take a short corner kick.
90+4' David Brooks (Bournemouth) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
90+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matt Doherty (Wolves) was quite harsh and Michael Salisbury didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Daniel Jebbison (Bournemouth) replaces Dango Ouattara.
89' Substitution. Thomas Doyle (Wolves) replaces Matheus Cunha.
88' Pedro Lima (Wolves) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
85' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Salisbury had an easy-decision to make.

83' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
80' Vitor Pereira prepares a substitution. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde is replaced by Pedro Lima (Wolves).
80' Substitution. Rayan Ait Nouri makes way for Pablo Sarabia (Wolves).
77' David Brooks (Bournemouth) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
76' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
73' Here is a change. Justin Kluivert is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Alex Scott (Bournemouth).
73' Substitution. Santiago Bueno is replaced by Nasser Djiga (Wolves).
72' Bournemouth are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
70' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
70' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
69' Wolves are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
65' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
60' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute James Hill and he is replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).
60' It's time for a substitution. Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) comes on in place of Ryan Christie.
60' James Hill (Bournemouth) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
59' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
58' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) sends the corner into the box, but Jose Sa intercepts it and averts the threat.
57' Wonderful movement by Bournemouth. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
55' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
53' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
53' The corner from Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is cleared away by the defence. The ball is out of play. Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner.

52' Corner kick. Wolves will have an opportunity. Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
51' The resulting corner from Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
51' The resulting corner, taken by Matheus Cunha (Wolves), comes to nothing. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolves.

50' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Wolves can continue in their attacking effort.
49' Wolves show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
47' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Vitor Pereira gives a chance to Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) and Joao Gomes is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Michael Salisbury blows for a foul.
45+1' Kepa Arrizabalaga (Bournemouth) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Joao Gomes (Wolves) gets booked.
44' The ball is out of play. Wolves will have a throw-in.
40' Bournemouth are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
36' 0 - 1 What a magnificent finish! Matheus Cunha (Wolves) wonderfully times his run onto a cross and thunders the ball from deep inside the box into the left side of the net!
34' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bournemouth. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.

34' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) unleashes a promising shot towards the left side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Jose Sa thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
31' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) has to leave the pitch!

30' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth), but referee Michael Salisbury must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
30' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
28' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.

27' Bournemouth show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.

23' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) attempts to threaten the goalkeeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. He produces a stunning blast which only flies inches over the crossbar. It could have been a beautiful goal! The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
22' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.

22' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Michael Salisbury with no other option than to blow for a foul.
22' Bournemouth are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
20' The game is interrupted. Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
17' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
16' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Jose Sa was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
15' Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul.

13' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
11' Wolves seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

10' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Kepa Arrizabalaga pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the right-hand post.
9' OFF THE POST! Good play from Nelson Semedo (Wolves) as skips past two defending players and from the edge of the box unleashes a decent strike that smashes the right post!
7' The resulting corner from Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is cleared by the defence.
6' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bournemouth, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
4' Michael Salisbury shows a yellow card to Santiago Bueno (Wolves) for his blatant foul.
2' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the right side of the goal, but Jose Sa is equal to it and makes an easy save.

2' Bournemouth slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bournemouth will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Michael Salisbury.
